v.3: What will show you what is the Catastrophe?
v.4: [It is] the day when mankind will be like scattered moths
v.5: and the mountains like carded wool.
v.6: As for him, whose deeds weigh heavy in the scales,
v.7: he will have a pleasing life.
v.8: But as for him, whose deeds weigh light in the scales,
v.9: his home will be the Abyss.
v.10: And what will show you what it is?
